title: Vaccine
description: One vaccine product. One file per vaccine in data/vaccines/<id>.json – the file name must equal the id.

id.description: Stable identifier, stored in the database. Never rename once released.

name.description: Trade name as printed on the package / in the vaccination card, e.g. "Twinrix Erwachsene".

aliases.description: Alternative spellings or regional names used for search.

diseases.description: Disease ids this vaccine protects against. Must exist in data/diseases.json (checked by bin/validate-data).

type.description: Relevant for minimum intervals between live vaccines.

variant.description: e.g. Twinrix Kinder vs. Erwachsene, Tdap vs. TDaP.

markets.description: ISO 3166-1 countries where the product is/was available.

sources.description: Reference, e.g. PEI or EMA product page.
